items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I'll never forget him. In fact, I do one of his songs now.

ctx.x: And he could put a song over like you know, nobody in the world could. I'll never forget him. In fact, I do one of his songs now. I started a little singing thing, I do one of his songs now. Every now and then, he was just great. Fact, all the entertainers in those days were great.
Now he was a singer and he also led a band for awhile?
